# Default privacy sweep patterns: credential shapes and generic personal-data forms.
#
# The sweep reports any added line that matches a line of this file. It also reads the
# repository's own .github/privacy/patterns.txt (extra lines, never written by the vend sync) and any
# --patterns FILE. Email addresses and IPv4 addresses have their own built-in rules.
#
# Format: one regular expression per line, matched case-insensitively. A line starting with # and an
# empty line are comments. Only syntax that Rust regex (ripgrep) and Python re read the same way is
# accepted, and the sweep refuses the file (exit 2) otherwise: literal letters, digits and
# @ _ : = % ~ ! & , / -, an escaped dot (\.), a bracket set of plain characters or ranges, and one
# + * ? or {n,m} after an atom. No wildcard dot, alternation, anchors, groups or class shorthands;
# add a line instead of an alternation. A bracketed letter (the [x] form) matches what the plain
# letter would but keeps the pattern from matching this file's own text. Write the shape, not the
# instance.
#
# Fail closed: a missing file, or one holding no patterns, or a line that does not compile, stops the
# sweep with exit 2.

# Secrets and tokens.
gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}
github_pa[t]_[A-Za-z0-9_]{22,}
gl[p]at-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20}
AKI[A][0-9A-Z]{16}
ASI[A][0-9A-Z]{16}
AIz[a][0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}
xox[abposr]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}
hooks\.slack\.com/service[s]/
sk_liv[e]_[0-9A-Za-z]{16,}
rk_liv[e]_[0-9A-Za-z]{16,}
sk-an[t]-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}
sk-pro[j]-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}
np[m]_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}
py[p]i-AgEIcHlwaS5vcmc[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,}
tske[y]-[A-Za-z0-9-]{10,}
glc_ey[J][A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}
ey[J][A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\.ey[J][A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}
-----BEGI[N]
://[A-Za-z0-9._-]+:[A-Za-z0-9._-]+@
